"""Main: new exact offline integration admission; no GPU or model launch."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
P = B / 'latest-update-integrated-neutral-controller-source-v5'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('integrated_admission_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8')

def pin(p):
    return dict(path=str(p), sha256=m.sha(p))

def read(p):
    assert p.is_absolute() and 0 < p.stat().st_size <= 16 << 20
    return json.loads(p.read_text())

def closed(record):
    assert record['passed'] and record['complete'] and not record['active'] and not record.get('error')
    assert record['commands'] and all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in record['commands'])

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'latest-update-main-integrated-admission-root-v2'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, commands=[], main_reviewed=True,
             gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, controller=pin(Path(__file__)))
    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    def write(name, value):
        target = out / name
        assert not target.exists()
        target.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')
        return pin(target)
    try:
        q = read(P / 'qualification.pending.json')
        assert {p.name:m.sha(p) for p in P.glob('*.py')} == q['controller_source_pins']
        cpu_path = B / 'latest-update-main-controller-cpu-root-v11/record.json'
        cpu = read(cpu_path)
        closed(cpu)
        assert cpu['main_reviewed'] and not cpu['gpu_executed']
        assert cpu['controller_source_pins'] == q['controller_source_pins'] and cpu['budget_stop_mock_quit_passed']
        q['receipts']['controller_cpu'] = pin(cpu_path)
        review = dict(passed=True, complete=True, active=False, main_reviewed=True, gpu_executed=False,
            controller_source_pins=q['controller_source_pins'], actual_cpu_receipt=pin(cpu_path),
            review='Main read v1 full sources and complete v2/v3 diffs, protocols, safety environment and independent whole input lineage; affinity CPU and once-STOP; strict incremental errors; balanced pairs; source-inferred clean route; input cap before hashing',
            scope='Source/CPU review only; actual native startup, whole input fit, numerical pairs and performance are pending')
        q['receipts']['controller_review'] = write('controller-review.json', review)
        reuse_path = B / 'latest-update-main-integrated-build-reuse-root-v2/record.json'
        reuse = read(reuse_path)
        closed(reuse)
        assert reuse['source_pins'] == q['production_source_pins']['xe'] and reuse['selected_revision'] == '0691bcdf5af63a85b3b25650f367d3276db64035'
        binary = q['binaries']['xe']
        assert all(reuse['binary'][k] == v for k,v in binary.items())
        base = dict(passed=True, complete=True, active=False, main_reviewed=True,
                    binary=binary, source_pins=q['production_source_pins']['xe'])
        build = dict(base, commands=reuse['commands'], original_reconciliation=pin(reuse_path),
            inference_executable_built=True, gpu_executed=False, compiler_provider='source-llvm-7.1.1',
            backend='xe', strata_enable_sycl=False, freshly_built_at_selected_commit=False,
            proof_kind=reuse['proof_kind'], original_build=reuse['original_build'],
            compiled_source_exclusion=reuse['compiled_source_exclusion'], scope='Existing exact ELF with equivalent compiled source closure; not a fresh build at selected commit')
        q['engines']['xe']['receipts']['build'] = write('build-reuse.json', build)
        runtime_path = B / 'latest-update-main-runtime-pins-root-v2/record.json'
        runtime = read(runtime_path)
        closed(runtime)
        actual = runtime['engines']['xe']
        e = q['engines']['xe']
        for field in ('health_binary','health_libraries','mapped_libraries','required_runtime_paths','extra_runtime_dirs'):
            e[field] = actual[field]
        health = read(Path(actual['health_receipt']['path']))
        closed(health)
        import re
        device = re.escape(health['device_discovery']['device_name'])
        e['expected_device_stderr_patterns'] = [r"strata generate: GPU " + device + r", [0-9]+ compute units, [0-9]+\.[0-9] GiB, prompt matrix products on XeStrata's own kernels \(.+\)"]
        e['expected_info'] = {}
        e.update(main_route_admitted=True, native_ple_admitted=True, selected_path_errors_are_fatal=True,
                 ignored_intermediate_event_errors_reviewed=True)
        runtime_review = dict(base, original_health_receipt=actual['health_receipt'], runtime_pin_receipt=pin(runtime_path),
            qualification_scope='Exact source LLVM native provider small integer probe and library identities; fresh exact-arm health mandatory before every actual model run',
            mapped_libraries=e['mapped_libraries'], health_binary=e['health_binary'])
        e['receipts']['runtime_review'] = write('runtime-review.json', runtime_review)
        source_review = dict(base, gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False,
            review='Native Xe source backend; direct per-layer host USM arena; issuer0; separate in-order copy/compute and event barriers; segmented verifier/device-plan0; chunk8192/group16; fused0/native-dequant-batch0/compact1/preload0; MTP-sync1 no-MTP no-op',
            cache_fill='All-profile per-layer continue until filled==want and duplicate profiles rejected on selected committed source',
            guard_scope='Final FP32-logit nonfinite detector; 324 synthetic actual device cases already PASS both modes; model output comparison remains pending',
            clean_environment='Validation/logging/STRATA_TRACE absent only for timing and heldout; all safety controls retained, guard is only within-pair environment delta',
            limitation='No current model fit/performance/full-logit/quality/full262144 certification')
        e['receipts']['source_route_review'] = write('source-route-review.json', source_review)
        model_path = B / 'latest-update-main-model-identity-v1.json'
        model = read(model_path)
        assert model['passed'] and model['complete'] and not model['active'] and model['main_reviewed'] and model['full_hashes_verified']
        q['model_identity_receipt'] = pin(model_path)
        q['model_inputs'] = model['model_inputs']
        q['tools'] = {name:pin(Path('/usr/bin')/filename) for name,filename in [('git','git'),('journalctl','journalctl'),('systemctl','systemctl'),('python','python3')]}
        held_path = B / 'latest-update-main-heldout-provenance-root-v1/record.json'
        held = read(held_path)
        closed(held)
        assert held['provenance_reviewed'] and held['tokens'] == 37462 and held['whole_document_preserved'] and not held['altered_to_fit']
        q['held_out_prompt'] = dict(main_reviewed=True, held_out=True, input=held['input'], tokens=held['tokens'],
            whole_document_preserved=True, preparation_receipt=pin(held_path))
        q.update(status='passed', main_reviewed=True, integrated_campaign_reviewed=True, clean_timing_environment_reviewed=True)
        qpin = write('qualification.json', q)
        code = "from pathlib import Path;from common import admit,load;from policy import HERE;import sys;q=load(Path(sys.argv[1]));admit(q,'xe',load(HERE/'production-source-pins.json'));print('PASS actual new integrated admission; no owner import/model launch')"
        c, so, se = owner.run('actual-integrated-admission', ['/usr/bin/python3','-B','-c',code,qpin['path']],ENV,P,
            wall=60,cpu=90,rss_cap=4<<30,text_cap=16<<20,file_cap=16<<20,total_cap=96<<20)
        r['evidence'] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0
        r.update(qualification=qpin, complete=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed'] = bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ('passed','error','qualification')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
